entities.text: High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The petitioner is an accused in connection with C.T. Case No.33 of 2021, pending before the Court of the learned Additional District & Sessions Judge-cum-Special Court under POCSO Act, Phulbani arising out of Phiringia P.S. Case No.53 of 2021 for alleged commission of offences under Section 363/366/376DA 376(3)/323/307/506/34 of IPC read with Section 4(2)/6 of the POCSO Act.

3. Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s.439 Cr.P.C. by the learned Additional District & Sessions Judge-cum-Special Court under POCSO Act, Phulbani, by order dated 12.01.2023 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.

4. Taking into account the nature of allegations and on going through the deposition of the victim aged about 13 years and keeping in view that the allegation is one under Section 376(D) of the IPC,
this Court is not inclined to entertain this bail application including the I.A. No.358 of 2023 at this stage.
5. Accordingly, the BLAPL along with I.A. No.358 of 2023 stands rejected.
6. Learned Court in seisin is called upon to expedite the trial.
(V. NARASINGH) Judge Santoshi Saroj Kanhar @ Pintu Kanhar vs State Of Odisha ....
